pages.c14-p01: Describe how card, contactless and mobile payments work and the systems involved
pages.c14-p02: Explain what fintech is and how app-based banks, open banking and APIs are changing financial services
pages.c14-p03: Explain how encryption, tokenisation, strong authentication and AI fraud detection protect digital payments
pages.c14-p04: Recognise common payment scams, explain why money muling is a crime, and describe how to protect yourself
pages.c14-p05: Explain what blockchain and cryptocurrency are, and evaluate their benefits and risks
pages.c14-p06: Evaluate the use of AI and data in finance and the move towards a cashless society, and design a responsible fintech solution
